findings.evidenceJa: 全身に繋げた魔術回路
findings.governingReading: the magic circuits connected throughout my body
findings.explanation: The bodily extent and plurality of Shirou’s activated circuit network disappear.

findings.highlight: he’s not bad, as guys go
findings.evidenceJa: 男としちゃあ悪くない
findings.governingReading: as a man, that is not a bad way to be
findings.explanation: Lancer’s approving judgment of Shirou’s boyish disposition becomes a comparison among men.

findings.highlight: You can be stupid and foolish
findings.evidenceJa: 馬鹿みたいに愚鈍で構わねえ
findings.governingReading: there is nothing wrong with being absurdly slow-witted
findings.explanation: The emphatic single judgment becomes an English tautology.

findings.evidenceJa: つまんねえ知恵つけて
findings.governingReading: you can pick up petty, cynical wisdom
findings.explanation: Lancer’s contempt for premature worldly cleverness becomes neutral learning.
Lancer reciprocates by disarming; the English instead claims he becomes generally unwary.
